settings.heading: Draft policy (legal review required)
settings.text:
Shipping. We deliver by courier throughout South Africa from Plettenberg Bay, Western Cape. Shipping rates and estimated delivery times are displayed at checkout before payment. NEEDS CLIENT INPUT: carriers, dispatch cut-off, delivery estimates by region, free-shipping threshold, international shipping (assumed none).

Returns (Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008). If goods are defective, damaged in transit or not what you ordered, tell us within 7 days of delivery at info@justmushrooms.co.za and we will replace or refund, including reasonable return shipping. Where you bought as a result of direct marketing, you may cancel within 5 business days of delivery (s16) and return the goods at your cost, provided they are unopened and sealed; a refund is issued within 15 business days. Because tinctures are consumable health products, opened or unsealed bottles cannot be returned unless faulty (s20(6)). Refunds go to the original payment method.
